chunks: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the words of God, Mighty and Majestic: 'formed and unformed' [22:5].

So he said: 'The formed ones are the primordial particles (al-dharr) whom God created in the loins of Adam (peace be upon him), taking the Covenant from them. Then He caused them to flow through the loins of men and the wombs of women, and they are the ones who come out into the world until they are questioned about the Covenant.

As for His saying 'and unformed,' they are every soul whom God did not create in the loins of Adam (peace be upon him) when He created the particles and took the Covenant from them. They are the sperms resulting from coitus interruptus, and the miscarriage before the Spirit, life, and permanence are blown into it.'

key_terms.الذَّرُّ: Al-dharr — the primordial particles/souls, created in Adam's loins before their earthly existence; central to Shia cosmological anthropology
key_terms.النُّطَفُ: Al-nutaf — seed drops/sperms; the material substance before ensoulment
key_terms.الْعَزْل: Al-'azl — coitus interruptus, a jurisprudential topic in Islamic law; here its theological significance is explained
key_terms.الْمِيثَاقُ: Al-mithaq — the primordial Covenant, when God asked all souls 'Am I not your Lord?' (Q7:172) and they affirmed
key_terms.غَيْرُ مُخَلَّقَةٍ: Ghayru mukhallaqa — unformed/incomplete, those that never received the covenant (azl sperms, miscarriages before ensoulment)
key_terms.مُخَلَّقَة: Mukhallaqa — formed/complete, referring to souls that received the covenant and will be born into the world

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir say about 'formed and unformed' in Quran 22:5?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) explains the Quranic phrase from Surah al-Hajj (22:5) distinguishing between 'formed' (mukhallaqa) and 'unformed' (ghayru mukhallaqa) embryos. The 'formed' are those primordial souls (al-dharr) that God created in the loins of Adam and bound with the primordial Covenant (mithaq), subsequently flowing through human lineages into the world to be questioned about that covenant. The 'unformed' are souls that never received this covenant — sperm resulting from coitus interruptus and miscarried fetuses before the spirit is blown in — thus standing outside the covenantal order.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, both together from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Muhammad Bin Al Noman, from Sallam Bin Al Mustaneer who said, ‘I asked Abu Ja’farasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [22:5] formed and unformed.

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The formed, they are the particles which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Created in the ribs of Adam<sup>as</sup>, Taking the Covenant against them. Then He<sup>azwj</sup> Make these flow in the ribs of the men and the wombs of the women, and they are the ones who are coming out into the world, until they would be Questioned about the Covenant.

And as for Hisazwj Words, and unformed, so they are persons whom Allahazwj did not create them in the ribs of Adamas when Heazwj Created the particles and Took the Covenant against them, and they are the sperms from the discharge, and the miscarriages before the Spirit is Blown into it, and the life and the remaining’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from all from al- Hassan ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Nu’man from Salam ibn al-Mustanir who has said the following: “I once asked abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, . . created and not created . . [22:5]

He (the Imam) said, ‘Created are those whom Allah created in the back of Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam. He made them to promise and make a covenant. Then He allowed them to move through the backs of men and wombs of women. They are the ones who come out in the world so that they are asked about the covenant.

His words ‘not created’ refer to every strand or trace that Allah did not create in the back of Adam, ‘Alayhi al-Salam when He created the particles and made them to form the covenant. They were the seeds that were not allowed to take place in the womb or were aborted before the spirit was blown in them as well as life and continued life.’”
